source: LLM-derived (Claude). Prompt: given the RUGD terrain classes and the robot below, label each class 1 if the robot can safely drive over it, else 0.
robot: Small skid-steer wheeled UGV (Clearpath Husky class, as used to collect RUGD): ~1 m long, ~15 cm ground clearance, handles packed or loose ground and gentle slopes, cannot climb obstacles taller than ~10 cm, not waterproof.
